## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem or link the related issue.

## Changes

Explain the meaningful implementation decisions and affected runtime boundaries.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and any limits. Include screenshots for visible changes
using sample or redacted data.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Applicable type and format checks pass.
- [ ] `pnpm verify:publication` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, private project data, or generated runtime bundles are included.
